status: machine-readable transcription of reports/mechanism_v2/prospective_gate_design.md; written and committed before any outer score exists
amendment_rule: These numbers may not be changed after any outer-fold outcome has been scored. A genuine pre-result software or integrity defect must be preserved and documented, not silently repaired into a pass.

estimand.aggregation: mean decisions within source/component/direction, then equal means over source x direction contexts
estimand.coverage: full candidate coverage is primary; selective coverage is secondary only
estimand.unit: connected biological component, both directions and cross-source remeasurements together

g4_leave_source.tasks: three sources withheld separately with connected-group purging, both directions

g5_cross_context.purging: connected groups held out across contexts; a measured mutant may never serve as its own transfer
g5_cross_context.paired_context_diagnostic: labelled diagnostic only, never the zero-shot gate

g6_small_edits.exact_snv_note: requires independent adequate evidence; absence is not generalization

g7_mechanistic_necessity.block_removal_multiplicity: Holm over all seven enumerated hypotheses; absent components get p=1 and no claim
g7_mechanistic_necessity.n10_stability: not applicable: independent stability admission failed; never zero-filled or reported as passed

g8_shortcut_resistance.interpretation: strong decodability alone neither proves nor disproves a shortcut

trans_clause.applies_when: the primary selected family is M7 and its trans block is retained
trans_clause.additional: paired context-identity necessity test must also hold; otherwise no trans claim is made and a failing selector is not excused

restricted_domain.only_prospective_domain: 2-10-nt interventions in the covered neuronal/neuron-like reporter contexts
restricted_domain.requirements: same useful-selection, distributed-benefit, matched, transfer, necessity and harm criteria on that domain
restricted_domain.post_hoc_domains: forbidden; no favorable outer subgroup may become a restricted domain
